newsitem.title: USA: MHC sees charge for takeover attempt.
newsitem.headline: MHC sees charge for takeover attempt.

text.p: Manufactured Home Communities Inc said Tuesday it expects its attempt to take over Chateau Properties Inc will cost the company a total of about $0.05 a share by year's end.
"That's a one-time expense," David Helfand, MHC's chief executive, said in an interview, adding that expenses related to the attempt were not included in third quarter results.
The cost is for the attempt alone and does not include gains or losses on the sale or purchase of securities, he said.

MHC launched a tender offer of $26 a share for Chateau last month after making an unsolicited merger offer in August. The tender offer expires at midnight Wednesday. Chateau had previously agreed to merge with ROC Communities Inc.
Earlier Tuesday, MHC reported third quarter earnings of $0.26 a share, up from $0.23 last year.
The mobile home park operator said its average occupancy for the third quarter was 94 percent. It said the average monthly rent per site was $309, versus $298 in third quarter last year.
